name: frame-loop
reason: nnMain loops the frame step (call at main+0x1e0b8a0, step at main+0x1dc7ed8) with no sleep until async init reaches nvnBootstrapLoader. Each frame dispatches FD4 jobs: SignalLightEvent per waiting worker (main+0x4023534, main+0x478fa50, main+0x4021de8) and BroadcastConditionVariable (main+0x4024894..0x40249a8). The frame count before nvnBootstrapLoader depends on wall time, so these calls vary run to run in both Lichii and the recomp.
